name: narration-chapters-near-budget
title: Every chapter is as long as its budget, within 30%, and none is more than 15% over it
why: docs/APP_GUIDE.md section 5.5 and prompts/script.md, prompts/rules_voice.md: a chapter more than 30% off its budget is a warning (chapter_off_budget); the budget is a ceiling, and the narration job writes a chapter that is more than 10% over it again once, so after the job none should be more than 15% over.
